title.narrative: Strengthening local women’s leadership and resilience ingender-just climate solutions and action across conflict settings - GAGGA

description.narrative: The purpose of the project is to support, analyse, document and advocate the gender-just climate solutions of women-led community-based organisations (CBOs) and women environmental and human rights defenders (WEHRDs) in the Global South experiencing structural violence and working at the nexus of climate injustice, gender injustice, and conflict.

title.narrative: Output 4 Case study analysis adapted for advocacy and influencing.

description.narrative: The case study analysis will be linked with GAGGA’s advocacy strategy to strengthen our efforts on influencing bilateral and philanthropic funders to increase resources to the nexus of climate injustice, gender injustice, and conflict. The analysis of the case studies will be adapted to advocacy and policy materials informing about the local and feminist perspective of the intersection of conflict, gender and climate.

title.narrative: Output 2 Case studies of CBOs documented and analysed in order to provide insights and recommendations to policy makers on the intersection of gender, conflict and climate from a local and feminist perspective

description.narrative: This activity will support the research, analysis and documentation of approximately 6 cases in three regions of CBOs part of the GAGGA network, working specifically in a conflict setting in the nexus of climate injustice, gender injustice, and conflict. Through the documentation and analysis of cases, the nexus can be analysed from a perspective of local women-led CBOs and provide insights and recommendations to policy makers on the intersection of gender, conflict and climate from a local and feminist perspective.

title.narrative: Output 3 Online Skillshare with participating CBOs and GAGGA partners selected regions

description.narrative: To accompany the documentation process and analysis of the nexus of climate injustice, gender injustice, and conflict, an online Skillshare will be organised centering the approximately six groups participating in the case study analysis to exchange strategies in how they respond in their situation and in their context to the challenges faced at the nexus. The GAGGA partners from all the regions will be invited to join.
